instructions: promptbench is a Tauri 2 + React 19 + Vite macOS desktop app (pnpm). Dark-first native glass shell. Authoritative design: docs/design-direction.md. Not a Next.js app — do not suggest App Router/RSC patterns. Prefer logic and regression findings over style nits.

rules.rule: Never call getCurrentWindow().setTitle() or Window.setTitle. setTitle resets custom trafficLightPosition on macOS (Tauri #13044). Keep title: "" and hiddenTitle: true in tauri.conf.json; page identity lives in-app.

CSS backdrop-filter / blur is allowed only on command palette and menus/popovers (tokens --glass-palette / --glass-popover). Never add backdrop-filter on the sheet, bench, scroll containers, canvas, sticky headers, tooltips, or toasts. Idle window must have zero CSS blurs. Never transition backdrop-filter.
Window dragging must use data-tauri-drag-region (deep on bench dead space). Do not reintroduce -webkit-app-region CSS — it is dead in WKWebView. Interactive controls must opt out correctly.
Supabase RLS must use auth.uid() = user_id equality (or equivalent). Never ship open/public write policies. workspace_id is an unused v1 seam — do not require it for access control yet.
UI session state (pane layout, local repo roots, window chrome UI) stays machine-local. Never persist absolute local filesystem paths or machine-only session fields to Supabase.
Theme changes must call getCurrentWindow().setTheme(theme) alongside toggling the .dark class. Default theme is dark. Without setTheme, dark app + light OS shows wrong vibrancy material.
Brand amber (--primary, hue 50) marks state only: running, current version, selected icon, focus, primary button. Do not flood amber across underlines, handles, and every selected tree icon at once.
